subject: literacy
concept: Evaluating whether an argument's evidence actually supports its claim
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts evidence cards into 'actually supports the claim' and 'doesn't really support it' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a claim to genuinely relevant supporting evidence versus irrelevant evidence
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a piece of evidence does or doesn't actually support a given claim

misconception_flags: accepts irrelevant or weakly connected evidence as sufficient support for a claim

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
